entries.sense_en: surrounded and held closely, as if in a warm embrace

synonyms.nuance: Neutral and everyday: simply be all around something, with no feeling of warmth.
Suggests a small, cosy place tucked safely inside something bigger.
synonyms.example: a cottage nestled in the hills

synonyms.nuance: Suggests a barrier or boundary; can feel closed off rather than protective.
synonyms.example: a garden enclosed by a high wall

entries.sense_en: very high and impressive

synonyms.nuance: Stronger: so tall it looks over everything below it.
Plain, everyday word with no sense of grandeur.
Stresses grand beauty and dignity, not only height.

entries.tip_ko: 'lofty ideals(고매한 이상)'처럼 추상적 의미로도 자주 쓰입니다.

entries.sense_en: gathered together in one place

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and general; any group coming together.
More formal and planned, often for a purpose or meeting.
Stresses a tight, packed group.

entries.sense_en: lived in a place

synonyms.nuance: The normal word today; dwell sounds literary or old-fashioned.
synonyms.example: They live in a small town.

synonyms.nuance: Formal or official; used on forms and in legal writing.
Takes a place as its object; often used for animals or whole peoples.

entries.sense_en: a person's face, especially its expression

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday word; says nothing about expression.
Literary; the face seen as grand or striking.
Only the look on the face, not the face itself.

entries.sense_en: a very steep rock face, like the side of a cliff

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; the standard term for a steep rock edge.
A rough, rocky, jagged rise rather than a smooth wall.
A broad, steep bank or headland, often less sheer than a precipice.

entries.sense_en: very heavy and large

synonyms.nuance: Common word for weight; does not suggest slow or clumsy.
Stresses huge size as well as weight, usually with a positive or neutral tone.
Heavy or bulky in a way that is awkward to carry or use.

entries.tip_ko: 글이나 말이 '지루하고 무겁다'는 뜻으로도 쓰입니다(ponderous speech).

entries.sense_en: kind and gentle, showing goodwill

synonyms.nuance: Warm and everyday; describes friendly people.
Stresses softness and lack of force.
Formal; actively wishing and doing good for others.

entries.sense_en: to happen; to become true

synonyms.nuance: Plain, everyday word for any event.
More formal than happen; used in writing and reports.
Used for hopes, dreams and predictions that are fulfilled.

entries.tip_ko: 성경식 표현으로 예언·약속이 실현될 때 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: the main meaning or point of a story or statement

synonyms.nuance: Informal; the basic idea with details left out.
synonyms.example: I got the gist of it.

synonyms.nuance: General word for what is meant.
Casual; the general direction of what someone is saying.

entries.tip_ko: 동사 purport(~라고 주장하다)와 강세 위치가 다릅니다: 명사 PUR-port.

entries.sense_en: strong, burning enthusiasm or eagerness

synonyms.nuance: Very strong feeling, often love or deep interest.
Energetic devotion to a cause or duty.
Common, milder word for eager interest.

entries.sense_en: kept something in the heart and held it dear

synonyms.nuance: Value something highly and keep it safe; often objects or memories.
Warm, slightly formal phrase; feel deep affection for a person, idea or thing.
Weaker and more general; think something is important.

entries.sense_en: whatever else was true; in any case

synonyms.nuance: Neutral, common; whatever the situation, this still holds.
synonyms.example: In any case, we must leave.

synonyms.nuance: Casual; often used to change the subject.
Slightly formal; introduces the one thing that is certain.
synonyms.example: At any rate, he is safe.

entries.sense_en: looking steadily for a long time, with love or wonder

synonyms.nuance: Look hard, often rudely or in shock; less warm than gaze.
A very quick look; the opposite of gaze in duration.
Stare with the mouth open in surprise.
synonyms.example: They gaped at the huge house.

entries.tip_ko: gaze at, stare at, glance at 모두 전치사 at과 함께 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: quiet and thoughtful, often a little sad

synonyms.nuance: Common; either deep in thought or kind to others.
Sadly longing for something past or out of reach.
Darker: quietly worrying or resentful.

entries.sense_en: quiet and modest; not drawing attention to oneself

synonyms.nuance: Not boasting about one's own achievements.
Hard to notice; about being unseen rather than personality.
Keeps feelings and opinions to oneself; can seem distant.

entries.sense_en: deep respect and awe, almost like worship

synonyms.nuance: Nearly the same; deep respect, often for sacred things.
Much weaker and more common; a good opinion of someone.
Stronger; religious devotion or adoring love.

entries.sense_en: clever at judging people and business chances, to one's own advantage

synonyms.nuance: General praise for intelligence, with no hint of slyness.
Formal and approving; sharp at judging situations, with no hint of slyness.
Negative; clever in a sly, tricky way.

entries.sense_en: impossible to understand or explain

synonyms.nuance: Strange and unexplained; may be exciting.
Simply cannot be understood, often because it is confusing.
Puzzling and hard to read, often of a person or smile.

entries.tip_ko: 'inscrutable face'는 속을 알 수 없는 무표정한 얼굴을 말합니다.

entries.sense_en: a brilliant shining light

synonyms.nuance: Soft, glowing brightness; often used of a happy face.
Very strong, sharp brightness.
Gentle, steady light, weaker than effulgence.

entries.sense_en: suddenly remembered and thought about

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for bringing something back to mind.
More formal; deliberately bring a memory back.
Casual; an idea comes to mind, not always a memory.
synonyms.example: I thought of her at once.

entries.sense_en: to that place

synonyms.nuance: The normal word today; thither is old and literary.
Plain explanation; used when the destination is already known.

entries.sense_en: was found in the end to be

synonyms.nuance: More formal; stresses that facts show it to be true.
synonyms.example: The rumor proved to be false.

synonyms.nuance: Casual; stresses the final state after a process.
synonyms.example: He ended up a rich man.

synonyms.nuance: Suggests a hidden truth is uncovered.
synonyms.example: He was revealed as a thief.

entries.sense_en: so used to something that it has become a fixed habit

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; used to something, good or bad.
Made tough or unfeeling by repeated exposure.
Everyday spoken form of accustomed.

entries.sense_en: when the proper moment came, after the right amount of time

synonyms.nuance: After a long time or many steps.
Very general; sooner or later.
Formal; at the proper stage of a process.
synonyms.example: You will be informed in due course.

entries.sense_en: people sent ahead to announce that someone important is coming

synonyms.nuance: One who announces news or a person's arrival.
Something that came before and led to a later thing.
synonyms.example: a forerunner of the modern car

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for any hint of what will happen.

entries.tip_ko: 'a harbinger of spring(봄의 전령)'처럼 자주 쓰입니다.

entries.sense_en: the habit of doing good and giving generously

synonyms.nuance: Everyday warmth toward others.
Willingness to give money or time freely.
Giving help or money to those in need.

entries.sense_en: the shape and features of a face, seen as showing character

synonyms.nuance: Plain word; no idea of reading character.
The parts of the face taken together.
Literary; the face as striking or expressive.

entries.sense_en: begging in an urgent, pleading way

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; ask for something with great need.
Formal and emotional; plead with deep feeling.
Make an emotional appeal, often to gain mercy.

entries.sense_en: shouted in a deep, loud voice

synonyms.nuance: General word for speaking very loudly.
Deep, powerful sound, like a lion or an angry crowd.
Sharp, loud cry, often in anger or excitement.

entries.sense_en: mean and greedy; caring only about money and selfish gain

synonyms.nuance: Dirty and wretched in look, usually about places.
Plain word for wanting too much; less moral disgust.
Stronger; extremely unpleasant or evil.

entries.sense_en: not serious enough to be blamed; easy to forgive

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; can be forgiven.
Reasonable given the situation; often minor.
Easy to sympathize with; no forgiveness needed.

entries.sense_en: between

synonyms.nuance: The everyday form; betwixt is old-fashioned or poetic.
Used for three or more things, not two.

entries.sense_en: put away in a place where it would be forgotten

synonyms.nuance: Move to a lower or less important position.
Send away by force; stronger than consign.
Plain, neutral word with no idea of finality.

entries.tip_ko: 'consign A to B'의 형태이며, 물건을 탁송하다는 뜻도 있습니다.

entries.sense_en: very famous and admired for great achievements

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; widely known, for any reason.
Respected for a long, impressive career.
Known widely for a special skill or quality.

entries.sense_en: weak in body, especially because of old age

synonyms.nuance: Thin and easily hurt; often about elderly people.
General; lacking strength for any reason.
Very weak, sometimes with a slightly pitying tone.

entries.sense_en: quiet rest and peace

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for stopping work or activity.
Calm with no trouble or noise.
A deep, lasting calm of mind or place.

entries.sense_en: jumping and dancing about playfully

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; show great happiness, often just in a figure of speech.
Play about in a lively, carefree way.
Move with high, springy steps, often to show off.

entries.sense_en: exactly, with no difference at all

synonyms.nuance: Plain, general word for perfectly matching.
Idiom; suits or matches perfectly.
synonyms.example: The job suits her to a T.

synonyms.nuance: Stresses that even small parts are the same.
synonyms.example: a copy down to the last detail

entries.sense_en: echoing and ringing back again and again

synonyms.nuance: Common word; sound bounces back once or more.
Fill a place with loud, ringing sound.
Clear, lasting sound like a bell.

entries.sense_en: taken in and absorbed, as ideas or wisdom

synonyms.nuance: Take in gradually; used for ideas and liquids.
Casual; take in eagerly.
Take in with pleasure and full attention.

entries.tip_ko: 원래는 '마시다'라는 뜻으로, 술을 마신다는 의미로도 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: fierce and ready to fight or quarrel

synonyms.nuance: General; ready to attack or push hard.
Wanting to start a fight or war; formal.
Wild and intense, in look or action.

entries.sense_en: able to speak in a fluent, powerful and persuasive way

synonyms.nuance: Able to express ideas clearly; less grand than eloquent.
Smooth and easy, especially in a language.
Good at convincing people, whether or not fine words are used.

entries.sense_en: powerful rulers

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for anyone who governs.
A king or queen specifically.
A cruel ruler; carries a negative judgment.

entries.sense_en: a procession of people on horseback or in carriages

synonyms.nuance: General word for people moving in order, often on foot.
Public show with marching, bands and floats.
A line of cars carrying an important person.

entries.sense_en: in a light, cheerful and hopeful way

synonyms.nuance: In a happy, pleasant way.
Carefree and confident, often in the way one walks.
Expecting good things; less about high spirits.

entries.sense_en: an open four-wheeled carriage pulled by horses

synonyms.nuance: General word for a horse-drawn passenger vehicle.
Closed, larger carriage for longer trips.
Small, light carriage, usually for one horse.

entries.sense_en: very sad, having lost hope

synonyms.nuance: Lost confidence after a setback; milder.
Sees no chance at all of things improving.
Everyday; sad and low in spirits.

entries.sense_en: loud and noisy in shouting

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for any loud sound.
Loud with shouting or demands; more formal.
Says opinions boldly; not necessarily loud.

entries.sense_en: wise, showing deep understanding

synonyms.nuance: Common word; good judgment from experience.
Careful and sensible about risks.
Formal; showing good judgment in a specific choice.

entries.tip_ko: 명사 sage는 '현자', 또 향신료 '세이지'라는 뜻도 있습니다.

entries.sense_en: a farmer

synonyms.nuance: The normal word today.
Poor farm worker in the past; can sound rude.
A hired worker on someone else's farm.

entries.sense_en: gray-white, like frost or old hair

synonyms.nuance: Plain color word.
Between black and white; the usual word for age.
Covered with or like frost; suggests cold.

entries.sense_en: with deep respect and awe

synonyms.nuance: Politely, with good manners.
As if adoring or praying; stronger.
With deep religious sincerity.

entries.sense_en: long chains of leaves or flowers hanging in curves

synonyms.nuance: A ring or chain of flowers, often worn or hung.
Circular ring of leaves or flowers.
A cloth or leaf decoration hung in a curve.

entries.sense_en: it seems to me

synonyms.nuance: Plain modern equivalent.
synonyms.example: It seems to me you're right.

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, simple opinion.
Softer, based on impression more than reason.

entries.sense_en: why; for what reason

synonyms.nuance: The normal word today.
Formal but modern way of asking why.
synonyms.example: For what reason did he leave?

entries.modern: "Wherefore are you sad?" → "Why are you sad?"
entries.tip_ko: 'Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo?'의 wherefore는 'where'가 아니라 'why'입니다.

entries.sense_en: before long; after a while

synonyms.nuance: Plain word; a short time from now.
After a long time or a long process.
Natural spoken equivalent.
